title: FairSSL: Fair Multimodal Self-Supervised Learning
abstract: arXiv:2508.16748v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Prevalent multimodal self-supervised learning (SSL) methods rely on the redundancy assumption: that different views share substantial task-relevant information. We argue that this assumption fails in complex, real-world settings characterized by heterogeneity (e.g., variable-length healthcare or behavioral data), where enforcing strict alignment can discard unique, modality-specific signals and inadvertently amplify bias. In this work, we propose FairSSL, a framework that leverages data heterogeneity as a resource for fairness rather than a hindrance. Unlike standard contrastive approaches, FairSSL uses a subject-aware Variance-Invariance-Covariance Regularization objective, where alignment is enforced across segments drawn from the same subject. translated_title: FairSSL：公平的多模态自监督学习
translated_abstract: 当前流行的多模态自监督学习（SSL）方法依赖于冗余假设，即不同视图共享大量与任务相关的信息。我们认为，在以异构性为特征的复杂现实场景中（例如长度可变的医疗或行为数据），这一假设并不成立——在这些场景中强制执行严格的对齐可能会丢弃独特的、模态特有的信号，并无意中放大偏见。在这项工作中，我们提出了FairSSL，这是一个将数据异构性作为公平性资源而非障碍的框架。与标准的对比学习方法不同，FairSSL采用了一种主题感知的方差-不变性-协方差正则化目标，其中对齐是在来自同一主题的片段之间强制执行的。我们引入了一种基于片段的池化策略来处理长度可变的模态，并对表征进行正则化，以促进 足够的主体内变异性， 跨（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: FairSSL提出了一个将数据异构性作为公平性资源的公平多模态自监督学习框架，通过主题感知的方差-不变性-协方差正则化目标和基于片段的池化策略，避免了严格对齐丢弃模态特有信号并放大偏见的问题。
en_tdlr: FairSSL proposes a fair multimodal self-supervised learning framework that leverages data heterogeneity as a resource for fairness, employing a subject-aware Variance-Invariance-Covariance Regularization objective and segment-based pooling to avoid discarding modality-specific signals and amplifying bias.
